title: S01 Two-metre Railway Side Platform
description: Original static two-metre railway side platform with two recessed concrete piers, full slab, separate light track-edge coping and rear steel railing. Platform top is 0.77 m above its actual ground plane; Y is the 2 m repeat direction. Intended placement X=1.25 m beside the original 1 m clear-gauge straight track leaves 70 mm between pier and sleeper envelopes and 84 mm between coping and inspection-trolley body envelopes. These are static visual placement measurements, not accessibility, loading, passenger-safety or engineering specifications. Editable fixed source and GLB components; no movement claim.
